title: Stop Saying "Very Dirty"! 5 Better English Words #shorts
description:
Stop saying "very dirty". Use one of these words instead:
• Filthy: filthy hands
• Grimy: a grimy window
• Squalid: a squalid room
• Foul: foul water
• Polluted: polluted air

Which one will you use today? Write it in the comments.
